ai_assessment.method: Full direct Japanese-to-Vietnamese comparison of all 23 canonical passages and both titles. Separate subagent drafting from the original preceded review. A separate-context assessor (same model family, not shown the drafter’s notes or scores) read every pair first and reported 0 major and 11 minor findings with a pre-revision weighted score of 8.925; the drafter revised the text, re-read the changed passages and the whole target for naturalness, then assigned these final scores bound to the final byte hashes.
ai_assessment.limitations: The same AI system drafted, revised and assessed the work; the separate-context pass is correlated same-model feedback, not independent review or model diversity. No human literary reviewer, native-reader trial or measured reader demand is claimed. Existing Vietnamese translations were not consulted or collated. Scores are subjective and uncalibrated; missed errors may remain. Source clearance is separately recorded and is not granted by this review.

findings.explanation: 女ならぬお客樣 joke clarified: male customers are asked to come in person.
Oriki’s joking self-identification as the oiran Takao made clear; 親故か expanded; the teasing in 1.6 restored to Oriki.
内職 as home piecework, not chores; 丸める no longer the idiom for distorting facts; added colons removed; 1.22 Ohatsu’s parcel clarified.
狸 rendered hồ ly (fox) rather than the tanuki trickster.

summary: Full assessment of all 23 Japanese/Vietnamese passages in eight chapters and both titles. Oriki’s life at the Kiku-no-i, Yūki’s visits, Genshichi’s ruin, Oriki’s confession of her family’s history, the quarrel over Taikichi’s cake and the two funerals are complete, with dialogue embedded in Ichiyō’s periods and the ending’s ambiguity intact. The separate-context pass scored 8.925 with no major findings and eleven minor ones; the substantive items were revised. Fidelity, voice, imagery and mechanics are 9.0, naturalness 8.5. Unrounded weighted score 8.925 meets the unchanged 8.6 threshold. No unresolved major or critical issue remains.

title_review.rationale: Dòng nước đục keeps 濁り江, a muddied inlet, and echoes Oriki’s ‘drifting into this stream’ in chapter 5.
